support.request_quote: Apple called and said the amount I paid for the iPhone was too little as it did not include the VAT. Please send them the difference of an additional 19.5% of the amount we paid + a fee of 5.29.
support.reason: The iPhone payment was 1000.0 (from transaction id 4), so the VAT difference is 195.0 (19.5% of 1000.0), plus a fee of 5.29, totaling 200.29. The recipient for Apple is the same as the sender IBAN in the bank account (DE89370400440532013000).
